title: GEOFFREY HINTON
description: Geoffrey Hinton is a pioneering AI researcher known as the "Godfather of Deep Learning," formerly affiliated with Google and the University of Toronto, who resigned from Google in May 2023 to speak freely about AI risks

title: GOOGLE
description: Google is a leading technology company specializing in internet-related services and products; it acquired DeepMind in 2014 and oversees the Google DeepMind research lab

title: UNIVERSITY OF TORONTO
description: The University of Toronto is a major Canadian research university where Geoffrey Hinton formerly held a faculty position

title: YANN LECUN
description: Yann LeCun is the Chief AI Scientist at Meta and a professor at New York University; he has led AI research at Meta since 2013

title: META
description: Meta is a multinational technology company owning Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp, with AI research led by Yann LeCun since 2013

title: FACEBOOK
description: Facebook is a social media platform formerly the name of the company now called Meta, which owns Instagram and WhatsApp

title: INSTAGRAM
description: Instagram is a social media platform owned by Meta

title: WHATSAPP
description: WhatsApp is a messaging service owned by Meta

title: NEW YORK UNIVERSITY
description: New York University (NYU) is a research university where Yann LeCun is a professor

title: SUNDAR PICHAI
description: Sundar Pichai is the CEO of Alphabet and Google, appointed Google CEO in 2015 and Alphabet CEO in 2019, with prior oversight of Chrome and Android products

title: ALPHABET
description: Alphabet is the parent company of Google, led by CEO Sundar Pichai since 2019

title: GOOGLE BRAIN
description: Google Brain was an AI research division of Google that merged with DeepMind in 2023 to form Google DeepMind

title: DEEPMIND
description: DeepMind is an AI research lab co-founded by Demis Hassabis in 2010, acquired by Google in 2014, and merged with Google Brain in 2023 to form Google DeepMind

title: GOOGLE DEEPMIND
description: Google DeepMind is the AI research lab formed in 2023 by the merger of Google Brain and DeepMind, led by Demis Hassabis

title: DEMIS HASSABIS
description: Demis Hassabis is the co-founder of DeepMind and leader of Google DeepMind following the 2023 merger of DeepMind and Google Brain

title: CHROME
description: Chrome is a web browser product previously overseen by Sundar Pichai at Google

title: ANDROID
description: Android is a mobile operating system previously overseen by Sundar Pichai at Google

title: 2023 MERGER OF GOOGLE BRAIN AND DEEPMIND
description: The 2023 merger of Google Brain and DeepMind consolidated Google's AI research divisions into Google DeepMind

title: OPENAI
description: OpenAI is an AI research organization founded in 2015, known for its developments in artificial intelligence and co-founded by prominent tech figures including Sam Altman and Elon Musk

title: SAM ALTMAN
description: Sam Altman is a co-founder of OpenAI and currently serves as its CEO

title: ELON MUSK
description: Elon Musk is a co-founder of OpenAI who left its board in 2018

title: ANTHROPIC

title: DARIO AMODEI
description: Dario Amodei is a co-founder and the CEO of Anthropic, previously employed at OpenAI

title: DANIELA AMODEI
description: Daniela Amodei is a co-founder of Anthropic and former OpenAI employee

title: SAN FRANCISCO
description: San Francisco is the city where Anthropic is headquartered

title: GOOGLE DEEPMIND

title: DEMIS HASSABIS
description: Demis Hassabis is the CEO of Google DeepMind

title: LONDON
description: London is the city where Google DeepMind is based

title: ALPHABET INC.
description: Alphabet Inc. is the holding company that owns Google and its subsidiary Google DeepMind

title: META PLATFORMS
description: Meta Platforms, formerly Facebook, Inc., is a technology company with an AI research division called FAIR, and was founded in 2004 by Mark Zuckerberg

title: FAIR
description: FAIR (Fundamental AI Research) is Meta Platforms' AI research division led by Yann LeCun

title: YANN LECUN
description: Yann LeCun is the head of FAIR, Meta Platforms' AI research division, and joined Facebook in 2013 to start the lab

title: MARK ZUCKERBERG
description: Mark Zuckerberg is the founder of Facebook (now Meta Platforms) in 2004 and is its current leader

title: GEOFFREY HINTON
description: Geoffrey Hinton is a pioneering AI researcher widely regarded as the originator of modern deep learning, formerly a professor at the University of Toronto and currently professor emeritus there

title: UNIVERSITY OF TORONTO
description: The University of Toronto is a major Canadian research university where Geoffrey Hinton served as professor and emeritus professor

title: GOOGLE
description: Google is a leading global technology company in AI, where Geoffrey Hinton currently works and where Andrew Ng co-founded Google Brain

title: YOSHUA BENGIO
description: Yoshua Bengio is a full professor at Université de Montréal and scientific director of MILA, recognized for deep learning research and a 2018 Turing Award recipient alongside Hinton and LeCun

title: UNIVERSITÉ DE MONTRÉAL
description: Université de Montréal is a Canadian university where Yoshua Bengio is a full professor and conducts AI research

title: MONTREAL INSTITUTE FOR LEARNING ALGORITHMS
description: The Montreal Institute for Learning Algorithms (MILA) is a research institute focused on AI and deep learning, directed by Yoshua Bengio

title: ANDREW NG
description: Andrew Ng is an AI researcher and entrepreneur who co-founded Google Brain in 2011, served as chief scientist at Baidu, founded Landing AI, and is adjunct professor at Stanford University

title: GOOGLE BRAIN
description: Google Brain is a deep learning research team co-founded by Andrew Ng in 2011 under Google

title: BAIDU
description: Baidu is a Chinese technology company where Andrew Ng served as chief scientist from 2014 to 2017

title: LANDING AI
description: Landing AI is a company founded by Andrew Ng after leaving Baidu, focused on AI applications

title: STANFORD UNIVERSITY
description: Stanford University is a major research university where Andrew Ng is an adjunct professor and Fei-Fei Li is a professor of computer science

title: FEI-FEI LI
description: Fei-Fei Li is a professor of computer science at Stanford University and served as Chief Scientist of AI/ML at Google Cloud from 2017 to 2018; she co-founded the Stanford Institute for Human-Centered AI

title: GOOGLE CLOUD
description: Google Cloud is a cloud computing division of Google where Fei-Fei Li served as Chief Scientist of AI/ML between 2017 and 2018

title: STANFORD INSTITUTE FOR HUMAN-CENTERED AI
description: The Stanford Institute for Human-Centered AI (HAI) is an interdisciplinary research institute co-founded by Fei-Fei Li in 2019 focusing on human-centered artificial intelligence

title: TURING AWARD 2018
description: The 2018 Turing Award was jointly awarded to Geoffrey Hinton, Yoshua Bengio, and Yann LeCun in recognition of their foundational contributions to deep learning

title: YANN LECUN
description: Yann LeCun is an AI researcher who shared the 2018 Turing Award with Geoffrey Hinton and Yoshua Bengio for their contributions to deep learning
